reconstruction_notes.en: Original fossil-shell specimen concept with very long transverse hinge wings continuous with a short convex folded/ribbed central shell. NHM named shell caption and PRI Remarks consulted for basic form only. Both preserved valve surfaces and restrained suture are geometric; no invented foot, pedicle, lophophore, colour evidence, exact species or copied specimen. Nominal0.10m hinge span, palette and simplified ribs/fold are art choices, not new fossil measurements; no living variant counted.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创化石壳体标本概念，极长横向铰合翼与短而凸起的褶肋中央壳连续。NHM具名壳体图注与PRI Remarks仅作基本形态参考。保存双瓣表面及克制接缝均为几何；不生造足、柄、触手冠，不主张化石原色、精确种或复制标本。0.10米名义铰合展幅、配色及简化褶肋为美术设定，非新测标本尺寸；不另计活体变体。

Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
